name: How long does a typical room remodel take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical room remodel take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a room remodel depends on its complexity and scale. A small cosmetic update, such as painting and new flooring, might take a few days to a couple of weeks. A more extensive renovation, involving demolition, new electrical or plumbing, and custom installations, could range from several weeks to a few months. We establish a clear timeline at the project's outset, considering all phases from design and material procurement to construction and final touches, to minimize disruption to your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Remodel timelines vary from days for cosmetic updates to several months for extensive renovations. We provide a detailed schedule upfront.
